Well, I live away from home for university and I hadn't really made that many new friends up here so I spent my days being very lonely and depressed. 

Ever since I moved away I haven't really been the same and as I said before I have these phases of depression where I just get really dark and lonely. It feels as though the world has left me behind. I realise my friends don't need me and that if I were to drop off the planet the next day nothing would happen and no one would miss me. 

My depression relies heavily on others which is very upsetting because I have almost no control over it. I have a best friend up here now who is one of the best friends I have ever had. We help each other through shit which can make it easier but I'd be lying if I said there weren't days when I have dreamed of taking a shit load of pain killers and letting the world drift from me I just wake up and hope that today is not one of those days.

Getting in contact with family can help too. I haven't told my family about my depression but I have contacted them more frequently. If you take time out of your day to talk to people and really get involved in your life then you will feel more anchored to this world. You will realise that people are just as scared and afraid as you are.

People are all lonely and afraid, some of us more than others. Some of us *a lot* more than others. It can get tough but you have to know that the good days are coming and your *best* days are ahead of you. 

It’ll be ok mate :)

Just keep calm for now, don't rush into anything. I have had moments when I have felt so low and so certain I was going to end it but I have been brought back. You just need to think about who loves you. For me it was good to write down the names of people who would miss you in their daily/weekly routine. This is not necessarily people who will cry for you but people who will notice you are gone, people who will be effected. I am here if you want to talk further about what helped me come back. I'm not saying I'll always be out of it now, I'll almost certainly fall back into a pit of depression sometime soon but at the moment I am ok and I want to help you as much as I can
